CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 3

3. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 20
   C. 21
   D. 9

4. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

5. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 33

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 42

7. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 48

8. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 33

9. Solve for x: x + 8 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 9
   C. 8
   D. 16

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 26
   C. 13
   D. 170

11. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

12. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 73
   D. 72

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: c² = 9² + 12²
3. c² = 81 + 144
4. c² = 225
5. c = 15
Final Answer: 15 cm
